title: A Democratic Party gig at the Beverly Wilshire
summary: Callender and Collette played for a party event in the same hotel as President Reagan.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, at this point, Buddy is busy doing a lot of small gigs. Like, the other night we played a gig for one of the political parties down at a hotel on Wilshire. I guess there's no point mentioning which one, because...
Well, that's all right. You can mention it.
It was the Democratic Party, but personally I don't think there's much difference between the parties.
And this was at what hotel? The Beverly Wilshire?

The Beverly Wilshire. The funny thing, President Reagan was staying in the same hotel, but the Democrats had rented the main ballroom that night, and the Republicans were a little late for that one. So we played there. You know, they're really pushing our Mayor for Governor.
